scoring_justification: Checker compares agent-reported trap energies, NEB barriers, and derived I-V metrics to paper-hidden references. The I-V metrics (leakage, Vth) are recomputed from the CSV, but the underlying electronic structures cannot be recomputed in the verifier sandbox.

hidden_assets.purpose: hidden reference values for trap energies, NEB barriers, and I-V target metrics
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Derived from the paper's band-structure figures (Al_Si+V_C trap at ~1.7 eV, Al_C three mid-gap levels, etc.) and the reported NEB barrier heights of 0.20 eV and 0.17 eV. I-V reference generated by a synthetic exponential model producing leakage 1e-13 A/µm and Vth ~2.12 V.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Values extracted from the paper's explicit numeric descriptions or figures, then baked into grading_spec.json. The I-V reference was constructed to be physically plausible for an Al_Si+V_C channel with n-type character (leakage 1e-13 A/µm, subthreshold swing 0.08 V/dec).
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Each value matches a quantitative statement or figure in the paper. The trap energies are directly described; the NEB barriers are explicitly stated. The I-V metrics are consistent with the observed transport trends (increased leakage, negative Vth shift) and the subthreshold slope described in the text.

outputs.description: Trap-level energies and Fermi-level character for each defect supercell.
CI-NEB energy barriers for the two Al_i + V_C migration paths.
I_d vs V_g transfer characteristic at V_d=0.3 V for the Al_Si+V_C channel.

output_contract.notes: All outputs will be compared to hidden reference values from the literature; tolerances are not disclosed to the agent. The entire pipeline must be executed; the process step is enforced by the load-bearing scored step.

reactions.pathway: Al displaces Si, Si migrates to V_C -> Al_Si+Si_C
